command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged reads against their pinned sha256 =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 1198ed07e41fdf6f53710dfe4eee376d978e1bf61f0d9dcdd8b7ec2ce7c5432e ERR188026_sub_1.fq.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' 6104ee4641702156ce3f5330b750db6fd461e597de43bb280158bc751a7e120a ERR188026_sub_2.fq.gz
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

tar -xf salmon-index.tar
rm -f salmon-index.tar          # free 1.6 GiB; 6.1 GiB of usable root is the whole budget
test -s sidx/index.ssi

echo "== salmon quant, library type inferred (-l A) =="
salmon quant -i sidx -l A -1 ERR188026_sub_1.fq.gz -2 ERR188026_sub_2.fq.gz -o squant -p 8

# salmon writes into squant/. Copy the artifacts to FLAT /tmp names before declaring
# them as outputs: an output whose parent dir is /tmp/squant would make spawn mount
# a root-owned host dir there. Flat /tmp is the only reliably writable destination.
cp squant/quant.sf                    quant.sf
cp squant/aux_info/meta_info.json     meta_info.json
cp squant/cmd_info.json               cmd_info.json
cp squant/logs/salmon_quant.log       salmon_quant.log

# ---- smoke check ----
# No python or jq in this image, so read the JSON with awk.
jget() { awk -v k="$1" 'match($0, "\""k"\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[-0-9.eE+]+") {
           s = substr($0, RSTART, RLENGTH); sub(/.*:[[:space:]]*/, "", s); print s; exit }' meta_info.json; }

# salmon 2.x reports this configuration as "deterministic" in its own log and
# reproduces its counts exactly, so anything derived from the inputs is asserted
# exactly. percent_mapped is banded: it is a property of these reads against this
# transcriptome, which a future salmon could legitimately shift by a point or two.
PROCESSED=$(jget num_processed)
MAPPED=$(jget num_mapped)
PCT=$(jget percent_mapped)
ECLASSES=$(jget num_eq_classes)
ROWS=$(tail -n +2 quant.sf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
TPMSUM=$(awk 'NR>1{s+=$4}END{printf "%.0f", s}' quant.sf)
READSUM=$(awk 'NR>1{s+=$5}END{printf "%.0f", s}' quant.sf)
EXPRESSED=$(awk 'NR>1 && $4>0' quant.sf | wc -l | tr -d ' ')

{
  echo "fragments_processed   $PROCESSED  want exactly 200000"
  echo "quant_sf_rows         $ROWS       want exactly 453553   (every transcript, zeros included)"
  echo "tpm_sum               $TPMSUM     want exactly 1000000  (TPM is a per-million normalisation)"
  echo "numreads_sum          $READSUM    want == fragments_mapped ($MAPPED)"
  echo "percent_mapped        $PCT        want 85..99           (observed 94.506)"
  echo "equivalence_classes   $ECLASSES   want 50000..95000     (observed 73772)"
  echo "expressed_transcripts $EXPRESSED  want 8000..30000      (observed 17731)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$PROCESSED" -eq 200000
test "$ROWS"      -eq 453553
test "$TPMSUM"    -eq 1000000
test "$READSUM"   -eq "$MAPPED"
test "$ECLASSES"  -ge 50000
test "$ECLASSES"  -le 95000
test "$EXPRESSED" -ge 8000
test "$EXPRESSED" -le 30000
awk -v p="$PCT" 'BEGIN{ if (p >= 85 && p <= 99) exit 0; print "percent_mapped " p " outside band"; exit 1 }'
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
